knowledge.title: Client profile refresh before suitability discussion
knowledge.answer: Complete an overdue or materially changed client profile before making a personalised investment recommendation. Confirm identity information, objectives, financial situation, risk capacity, and relevant changes. Escalate discrepancies through the approved compliance channel.

knowledge.title: Fixed-deposit maturity conversation
knowledge.answer: Start with the client's liquidity needs, time horizon, and upcoming commitments. Present deposit renewal, liquidity, and investment alternatives as separate choices. Do not imply that investment returns are guaranteed or equivalent to deposit protection.

knowledge.title: Client contact preference and consent
knowledge.answer: Use the client's recorded permitted channel and timing preference before initiating outreach. If consent is missing, unclear, or contradicted by a recent request, pause campaign-style contact and confirm the permitted method through an approved service interaction.

knowledge.title: Cross-border transfer preparation
knowledge.answer: Confirm the source, purpose, destination, timing, and required supporting documents before discussing transfer execution. Explain fees and exchange-rate mechanics using current approved information, and do not forecast currency movements.
